what_it_is: An online store selling outdoor clothing and equipment to signed-in customers through a web front end (and a mobile app), with orders accepted, stock-checked, paid and shipped by back-end services joined by a message broker. Configuration described: the Aspire AppHost (eShop.AppHost/Program.cs:1-104) as deployed to Azure Container Apps (eShop.AppHost/Program.cs:6), with UseFoundry=true so the chat and embedding models are present (eShop.AppHost/Program.cs:80-85; Ollama is hard-coded off at :87-91); Postgres, RabbitMQ and Redis run as the application's own containers (eShop.AppHost/Program.cs:8-19). proposed: no source says which configuration runs in production; this is the fullest the repository defines. In this configuration the services run outside Development, so /health is not mapped (eShop.ServiceDefaults/Extensions.cs:115-125) and logs default to Information (Ordering.API/appsettings.json:4).
